details.name: Machine Learning Round
details.display_text:
Teams will receive the problem statement and dataset on Day 1 and have until Day 3 to submit their solutions. Teams can track their performance through the leaderboard, which will reflect team rankings live over the course of this challenge. There will be a private leaderboard that will be revealed after the hackathon, based on your final solution submission and validation on the complete test dataset.

Note: Datasets will be visible only to all team leaders after clicking on the code button.

Please refer to this video for a better understanding of the problem statement: Click Here
